name: WhatSThis_8
short_caption: The robot extends its right hand forward with an open palm while slightly tilting its head to inquire about an object or concept.
movement_description: The robot starts from a neutral posture and raises its right arm forward with the palm facing upward, opening its hand as if presenting or questioning something. At the same time, it slightly tilts its head to the left to convey curiosity or inquiry. It briefly holds this pose before smoothly lowering its arm and returning its head to the neutral, centered position.
